events.subtitle: Two-piano duo
events.factual_description: Blue Note Tokyo presents Bill Charlap and Renee Rosnes as a two-piano duo on March 17-19, 2027. Each date has sets at 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM, with doors at 5:00 PM and 7:45 PM. The official page names only Charlap and Rosnes, both on piano, and frames the engagement around the contrapuntal partnership documented on their 2010 duo album Double Portrait. The music charge is ¥9,900 before seat-specific charges; member reservations begin November 30 and general web reservations December 7.

en.why_it_matters: The reason to keep this is the two-piano design, not two famous names sharing a bill. Charlap's songbook-centered touch and Rosnes's more angular harmonic motion have to negotiate the same register without bass or drums, making counterpoint, spacing and accompaniment roles the live subject of the evening.
en.trip_verdict: If Tokyo dates overlap, choose one of the six sets when a close acoustic piano conversation fits the evening. The three-day run makes this a strong convenient option rather than a reason to displace another priority or reshape the trip.

es.why_it_matters: La razón para conservarlo es el diseño de dos pianos, no dos nombres famosos en el mismo cartel. El toque centrado en el cancionero de Charlap y el movimiento armónico más angular de Rosnes tienen que negociar el mismo registro sin bajo ni batería; contrapunto, espacio y funciones de acompañamiento se vuelven el tema vivo de la noche.
es.trip_verdict: Si las fechas coinciden con Tokio, escogería uno de los seis sets cuando encaje una conversación acústica cercana entre pianos. La serie de tres días lo vuelve una opción fuerte por conveniencia, no una razón para desplazar otra prioridad o rehacer el viaje.

events.artist: Yoichi Murata Big Band featuring Ivan Lins
events.subtitle: First live collaboration
events.category: Brazil-Japan lineage / Big band / First live collaboration
lineup: Yoichi Murata — trombone, leader, composer, arranger
Ivan Lins — vocals, keyboards; special guest
events.factual_description: Blue Note Tokyo presents Yoichi Murata Big Band featuring Ivan Lins on Tuesday, February 23, 2027, with sets at 4:30 PM and 7:30 PM and doors at 3:30 PM and 6:30 PM. The presenter identifies it as the first live collaboration between Murata's big band and Lins, following Murata and Lins's 2010 collaborative album Janeiro. The official page names the complete 18-person ensemble, with Murata leading and arranging, Lins singing and playing keyboards, five saxophones, four trumpets, four trombones, piano, guitar, bass and drums. The music charge is ¥11,000 before seat-specific charges; member reservations begin November 28 and general web reservations December 5.

en.why_it_matters: This is a concrete Brazil-Japan exchange rather than a generic guest spot: Murata is placing Ivan Lins's harmonic and song language inside an exact 17-piece Japanese big-band architecture, extending their 2010 Janeiro recording relationship into its first live meeting. Five reeds, four trumpets, four trombones and a full rhythm section give the arranging choices enough scale to transform the material rather than merely accompany it.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for one set if Tokyo is in the late-February plan, especially for Brazilian songwriting, Japanese large-ensemble arranging or living-master lineage. One date gives it focus, but two sets and five other nearby Ivan Lins performances make A+ the calibrated ceiling.

es.why_it_matters: Es un intercambio Brasil-Japón concreto, no una participación genérica: Murata coloca el lenguaje armónico y de canción de Ivan Lins dentro de una arquitectura exacta de big band japonesa de 17 músicos, llevando al escenario por primera vez la relación discográfica de Janeiro de 2010. Cinco cañas, cuatro trompetas, cuatro trombones y sección rítmica completa dan a los arreglos escala suficiente para transformar el material y no sólo acompañarlo.
es.trip_verdict: Le haría espacio activamente a uno de los sets si Tokio está en el plan de finales de febrero, sobre todo por composición brasileña, arreglos japoneses de gran ensamble o linaje de maestros vivos. La fecha única le da foco, pero dos funciones y otras cinco actuaciones cercanas de Ivan Lins fijan el techo calibrado en A+.
